notes: You can now test your API keys right in Settings before you need them. FoodFinder's Spoonacular (restaurant menus) and USDA (food database) key fields each get a 'Test Connection' button, so you'll know a key works instead of hitting a surprise error mid-meal at a restaurant. We also gave every PowerPack 'Test Connection' button the same clean, consistent look across FoodFinder, LoopInsights, and AutoPresets.
